title: Northgate Tire Center Service Plan Schedule: Rotation, Rebalancing, Flat Repair and Roadside Assistance
content:
# Northgate Tire Center — Lifetime Service Entitlements

For the life of a Northgate Tire Center package, the package states whether rotations, rebalancing and repairs of repairable flats are included, the fee where each is not, the rotation interval the Tire Center recommends, the limits of a repairable puncture, and the months of flat-tire roadside assistance from installation.

## Rotation and rebalancing

| Package | Rotations included for life | Rotation fee per visit where not included (USD) | Recommended rotation interval (miles) | Rebalancing included for life | Rebalancing fee per tire where not included (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Tire Mount & Balance | no | 19.99 | 5000 | no | 10.00 |
| Northgate Tire Installation Package | yes | 0.00 | 5000 | yes | 0.00 |
| Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package | yes | 0.00 | 5000 | yes | 0.00 |
| Northgate Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard | yes | 0.00 | 5000 | yes | 0.00 |
| Northgate Premium Tire Care | yes | 0.00 | 5000 | yes | 0.00 |
| Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard | yes | 0.00 | 5000 | yes | 0.00 |

## Flat repair and roadside assistance

| Package | Repairable flats included | Flat repair fee where not included (USD) | Largest repairable puncture (inches) | Tread area only | Roadside assistance from installation (months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Tire Mount & Balance | no | 15.00 | 0.25 | yes | 0 |
| Northgate Tire Installation Package | yes | 0.00 | 0.25 | yes | 0 |
| Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package | yes | 0.00 | 0.25 | yes | 0 |
| Northgate Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard | yes | 0.00 | 0.25 | yes | 0 |
| Northgate Premium Tire Care | yes | 0.00 | 0.25 | yes | 12 |
| Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard | yes | 0.00 | 0.25 | yes | 0 |

## Notes on the schedule

- Northgate Tire Mount & Balance is the one package with a rotation fee ($19.99 per visit), a rebalancing fee ($10.00 per tire) and a flat repair fee ($15.00); on every other package each of those fees is $0.00.
- Every package recommends a rotation every 5000 miles and repairs punctures up to 0.25 inches across, in the tread area only.
- A roadside assistance figure of 0 months means the package carries no flat-tire roadside assistance; Northgate Premium Tire Care carries 12 months from installation.
